_comment: Drop the `hooks.Stop` entry into your ~/.claude/settings.json (or project settings.json). When Claude Code is about to end a turn, this hook runs `clawbio-flow status --check-bundle` in CWD. If a clawbio-flow run is finished but `clawbio-flow bundle` has not been called, the hook exits non-zero and Claude Code is reminded to bundle before stopping.
